articles.summary: Ameris Bank has joined the Military Spouse Employer Partnership, a federal recruiting initiative that connects military spouses with employers. The partnership is part of SpouseWorks, which helps military spouses pursue education and career opportunities. Through the partnership, Ameris Bank will highlight job openings across its markets and help military spouses find and apply for roles that match their skills and experience. Opportunities span retail banking, operations, technology, customer support, risk management, finance and other areas of the bank. “Frequent moves can make it hard for military spouses to build a career,” said Palmer Proctor, CEO of Ameris Bank. “We want to make it easier for them to find opportunities at Ameris. Military spouses bring skills and experience we value, and we look forward to meeting more of them through this partnership.” For more information about career opportunities at Ameris Bank, visit the bank’s careers page . articles.title: Ameris Bank Joins National Partnership to Recruit Military Spouses

articles.summary: Ameris Bancorp (NYSE: ABCB) (“Ameris”) and Lakeland, Florida-based Bank of Central Florida Holding Company, parent company of Bank of Central Florida, today announced the signing of a definitive merger agreement pursuant to which Ameris will acquire Bank of Central Florida Holding Company in an all-stock merger transaction. Bank of Central Florida operates seven financial centers in the greater Lakeland/Tampa area.
